method: Every feature bucketed into deciles; each decile scored on close-to-close return, on best and worst excursion inside the window, and on the probability of clearing 25/50/100bp. Ranked by the separation between the top and bottom deciles in standard errors of the difference.

cost.note: Spread observed on the tape: 0.369bp, charged on both legs. The minute-resolution estimators said 5.08bp — 14x the measured value, which is what reading a price path at one-minute resolution does to a bounce estimator.

rows.refused: 13% of minutes ran off the end of the published curve — the median below that is computed on the deep minutes only and understates the cost
